thread:
jamie-cs: Quick check — EdgeBridge week0 private deploy: audit logs not reaching their Splunk endpoint. Their ops see s3 PutObject 403 and a KMS Decrypt failure. Anyone seen this pattern? @marco-net @priya-se
marco-net: On it. Can you paste the exact error snippet or logs?
jamie-cs: From their engineer: "AccessDenied: PutObject" with x-amz-request-id present. Also an entry: "KMS:Decrypt failed for RequestId" — attached small log line.
priya-se: That points to a KMS key policy / cross-account permissions issue or region mismatch. Do we have their key ARN and did they grant our service principal?
jamie-cs: They sent ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh. But they also said they originally created the key in us-east-2 — possible mismatch.
marco-net: Region mismatch will break Decrypt if S3 and KMS are in different regions for a non-MRK. Confirm S3 bucket region first.
jamie-cs: S3 bucket is in us-east-1. I'll confirm with EdgeBridge. Meanwhile audit-bot: please paste the delivery failure line.
audit-bot: hook:log-delivery failed error=AccessDenied object=redwood-edge/edge-logs/20251112-160212.json request_id=req-0a1b2c3d timestamp=2025-11-12T16:02:12Z
priya-se: If they want to keep the key in us-east-2 we can recommend either creating a multi-region CMK or rekeying in us-east-1. Fastest fix: create a CMK in the same region as the S3 bucket or reconfigure encryption to use the us-east-1 key. Also ensure key policy explicitly grants our service principal and any cross-account roles.
jamie-cs: Triage plan: 1) Confirm KMS region and S3 region, 2) Ask them to update key policy to include our principal (example below), 3) Check VPC endpoint policies that might block s3:PutObject. Scheduling a 30m call in ~1h to walk through. Any other blockers?
marco-net: Add a request to check endpoint policies — if they use an S3 VPC endpoint with a restrictive policy it can deny PutObject even if IAM/KMS are fine. Make sure endpoint allows s3:PutObject and kms:Encrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey.
jamie-cs: Including a short checklist for them:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-log-forwarder" },
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```and an example S3 endpoint policy to permit PutObject.
edgebridge-ops: Thanks — we rekeyed into us-east-1 and updated the policy to include the Redwood role. After that we retried and saw log delivery succeed. One remaining thing: we see intermittent latency spikes on PutObject (3–4s).
priya-se: Latency spikes are likely egress/network path or transient S3 throttling. We'll keep an eye via Console traces and recommend enabling batching on the forwarder to reduce request rate. Marking account health as: green for onboarding, low renewal risk but note cutover dependency on key/endpoint config.
jamie-cs: :thumbsup: I'll leave this thread open for 24h to confirm stability, then send the enablement survey and close. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
